notes.title: v1.10 - Exploration map
notes.notes:
Exploration is the focus of The Last Explorer, but it can become annoying when you can't find that one last thing and you have no idea where to start looking

[h3]The Last Explorer is designed to naturally guide/attract you to places of interest, so it is absolutely possible and encouraged to explore without any other help[/h3]

But if you'd like some help there is now a map which you can find

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43882854/9d8f901bf938386db73f556198c99187ec8fd65b.png[/img]

[b]By interacting with this map it will reveal (in a broad radius) undiscovered landmarks & quests.[/b]

notes.title: v2.19 (Beta Demo) - Steam Deck Support
notes.notes:
[h2]I'm excited to announce that The Last Explorer now works on the Steam Deck![/h2]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43882854/9029733afa7466972e00c31d156e6ce17e58af0a.png[/img]

[h2][u]IMPORTANT:[/u][/h2]
I made some changes to the default controller button mapping and graphics settings, if you've played the game before and want to play on Steam Deck please go into 
[b]Options > Controls > Back to default[/b] 
[b]Options > Graphics > Back to default[/b]

[h3][b]Most important Steam deck related changes:[/b][/h3]
• Improved performance
• Improved shadows on low end hardware
• Made the game detect when the player is on Steam Deck
• Added graphics preset for Steam Deck
• Much better default controller mapping
• Better menu navigation with controller

[h3]Known issue[/h3]
The studio logo doesn't play properly on the Steam Deck, I am working on a fix asap but meanwhile it shouldn't affect the game in any way (if you find any other issues please let me know!)

[h3]Steam Deck graphics preset[/h3]
The default Steam Deck graphics settings (although perfectly playable in my experience) focus on getting good looking results more than high framerates, this is due to the nature of the game. If you'd like higher framerates, feel free to tweak the graphics settings to your liking!

---

[b]Full patch notes[/b]
version 2.19
• Made the game detect when the player is on Steam Deck
• Added graphics preset for Steam Deck
• Removed display mode setting on Steam Deck
• Removed export photo option on Steam Deck

• Improved performance
• Improved shadows on low end hardware
• Slightly improved fog on low end hardware

• Fixed controller bug when clicking on social media button

• Fixed bug with the back button on controllers

version 2.18

• Fixed bug with time dilation when in freecam mode
• Fixed player drowning while in freecam mode
